correctionReason: The initial calculation substituted y(π/2)=3/2 instead of y(π/2)=1; this is an independent calculation error, not an input omission.
adjudicatedDerivation: At t=π/2, (x,y)=(1,1) and dy/dx=0, so l is y=1.
The next t in (π/2,2π) with y=1 solves cos²t=0, hence α=3π/2.
Speed is |1+sin t cos t|=1+sin t cos t on [π/2,3π/2].
Distance = ∫(1+sin t cos t)dt from π/2 to 3π/2 = π.
